_readme: TERM-064 / FB-S2-02. The recorded population that is NOT the one ticker resolver
(api/services/ticker_resolver.py). tests/test_ticker_resolver.py fails BY NAME on a
resolver function or a restated stop vocabulary not listed here, and on a listed one
that no longer exists (this file may only shrink). A function that DELEGATES to
ticker_resolver is not a second resolver and never belongs here.
Migrating any entry below is a follow-up in

functions.name: parse_ticker
functions.reason: Parses an OPRA option contract symbol (O:AAPL260821C00150000) into root/expiry/side/strike; a contract decoder, not free-text ticker resolution.

functions.name: extract_symbol
functions.reason: Reads the equity symbol out of a SnapTrade activity's structured symbol field; broker data, no text to disambiguate. Journal 2.0 broker path, not migrated here.

functions.name: _resolve_symbol
functions.reason: Maps an app ticker to Massive's vendor symbol (entity-master vendor_symbol, else to_polygon_symbol); the dual-class REST boundary itself, which must stay separate from resolution.

functions.name: extract_tickers
functions.reason: Tweet ingest: M5's cashtag-only grammar, owned by A8 (TERM-075, a8Taxonomy.json, shared with JS). Converging M5 with the resolver's cashtag tier is a follow-up, not this ticket.

functions.name: parse_tickers
functions.reason: Splits an explicit comma-separated ?tickers= query parameter; the caller already named the symbols, nothing is resolved from prose. Wisdom program scope.

functions.name: _resolve_tickers
functions.reason: Offline audit CLI: turns --tickers / --basket arguments into a list; an argument parser, not a product resolver.

functions.name: extract_tickers
functions.reason: Offline theme-curation tool: parses 'TICKER - reason' lines of a list-mode model answer by line position; a line-format parser whose output an operator reviews.

vocabularies.reason: Discord /buzz HOUSE_VOCAB: the room's own jargon, derived from #main-chat's corpus with owner recall rulings; a different input kind with its own measured vocabulary.
Report-card safety check over MODEL ANSWERS (price_without_tool); an eval harness token filter, not a product resolver.
Notebook Ask retrieval token filter over a member's question; Notebook workstream scope, not migrated by this ticket.
